closed_release_blocker.closure_reason: Every target has a retained fresh-container transcript from prerequisite installation through verified shutdown, and the one procedure defect has a passing clean rerun.

remaining_boundaries: OCI containers share the host kernel and do not validate native boot, distribution kernel behavior, systemd, desktop integration, hardware, host firewall, or host networking.
No packaged service, native installer, reverse proxy, TLS termination, managed secrets, backup automation, HA, rolling upgrade, or production hardening is claimed.
Windows 10/11 and WSL behavior require actual Windows hosts and remain outside this Linux report.
Health and readiness responses prove only the observed application responses.

summary.result: All five documented Linux userspace source-install sequences passed in retained clean containers. This closes the Linux userspace evidence blocker without promoting OCI evidence to native clean-host evidence.
